title: Amnon and Tamar

questions.question: Who was the beautiful sister of Absalom?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:1 (ESV): "Now Absalom, David's son, had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar."

questions.question: Who fell in love with Tamar?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:1 (ESV): "...And after a time Amnon, David's son, loved her."

questions.question: Who gave Amnon advice on how to get Tamar?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:3 (ESV): "But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab... a very crafty man."

questions.question: What did Amnon do to Tamar?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:14 (ESV): "...he violated her and lay with her."

questions.question: How did Amnon feel about Tamar after the incident?
options: He hated her with very great hatred
questions.correctAnswer: He hated her with very great hatred
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:15 (ESV): "Then Amnon hated her with very great hatred, so that the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her."

questions.question: Where did Tamar put ashes?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:19 (ESV): "And Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the long robe that she wore..."

questions.question: How long did Absalom wait before taking revenge on Amnon?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:23 (ESV): "After two full years Absalom had sheepshearers at Baal-hazor..."

questions.question: Where did Absalom invite the king's sons to?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:23 (ESV): "...Absalom had sheepshearers at Baal-hazor... and Absalom invited all the king's sons."

questions.question: What command did Absalom give his servants?
options: Kill Amnon when his heart is merry with wine
questions.correctAnswer: Kill Amnon when his heart is merry with wine
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:28 (ESV): "...Mark when Amnon's heart is merry with wine... then kill him."

questions.question: Where did Absalom flee after killing Amnon?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:37 (ESV): "But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur."

questions.question: Who was Jonadab's father?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:3 (ESV): "...Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David's brother..."

questions.question: What kind of robe was Tamar wearing?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:18 (ESV): "Now she was wearing a long robe with sleeves, for thus were the virgin daughters of the king dressed..."

questions.question: What false report came to David initially?
options: Absalom has struck down all the king's sons
questions.correctAnswer: Absalom has struck down all the king's sons
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:30 (ESV): "...news came to David, 'Absalom has struck down all the king's sons, and not one of them is left.'"

questions.question: Who corrected the false report?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:32 (ESV): "But Jonadab... said, 'Let not my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men... for Amnon alone is dead.'"

questions.question: How long did Absalom stay in Geshur?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 13:38 (ESV): "So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years."

key_verse_text: Then Amnon hated her with very great hatred, so that the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. (ESV)
